compact_H3_face.proof: The four exact future timelike dual rays generate the complete four-wall halfspace cone in the common-face span; its projectivization is a compact tetrahedron. All four vertices satisfy every other inequality strictly, so no old wall truncates it.

new_vertex_edge_frontier.scope: All outgoing rank8 spherical edges of the four new vertices, with every possible ninth wall checked. This is not the frontier of every inherited vertex.
